description: List all 5,570 Brazilian municipalities (or filtered by 2-letter state code) with IBGE codes. IBGE CC BY 4.0

limit.description: Max municipalities to return (default 200, max 2000 — useful for pagination).

uf.description: Optional 2-letter Brazilian state code (e.g. "SP" for São Paulo, "RJ" for Rio de Janeiro). If omitted, returns all 5,570 municipalities.

name: gov.ibge.municipalities

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Brazilian Municipalities
